name: Blueprint
description: Creates the instance's children from a map of steps: one instance of the child schema per step, created with its link to the instance and blocked by the children of the steps it comes after, all in one transaction that a failure refuses whole. The steps are inline in the config, stamped when the instance is created, or held by a definition the instance links to, pinned to a revision, stamped when that link is first set, by the create that gives it or a later link. A step can depend on the instance's fields (when); a step left out passes its dependencies on to the steps that come after it.

schema.description: The child schema. It composes Links with parentLink, Constants over keyField and every copied field, Dependencies when a step comes after another, and not Blueprint.

parentLink.description: The link of the child schema's Links config that points at this schema; each child is linked to its parent through it.

keyField.description: A string field of the child schema's type that each child gets its step's key in.

steps.description: The steps, by key, stamped when the instance is created.

after.description: The keys of the steps whose children block this step's child.

when.description: Stamps the step only when the instance's field equals a value, or is a list that includes one; absent, always.

field.description: A field of this schema's type.

equals.description: The value the field must equal, as JSON.

includes.description: A value the field, a list, must include, as JSON.

data.description: Fields of the child, beside its key and the copied fields.

from.description: Where the steps are kept as an instance: a pinned link of this type's Links config, and the field of the linked instance that holds a map of steps of the same form as steps. The steps are read from the revision the link pins and stamped when the link is first set, by the create that gives it or a later link.

link.description: A pinned link of this type's Links config.

field.description: The field of the linked instance's type that holds the steps.

copyFields.description: Fields of this type copied to every child, a field of the child's type of the same name.

copyLinks.description: Links of this type copied to every child, a link of the child's Links config of the same name to the same schema, keeping the revision a pinned one records: the links the instance holds when it is stamped, which for inline steps are the ones its create gives.

fields.name: blueprint
fields.description: What was stamped: children, each step's key and its child's id, in the order they were created; absent until the instance is stamped.
